name: IOIPG
recent: IOIPG 正在推进其房地产投资信托（REIT）的首次公开募股（IPO），机构与最终零售发售价已定为每单位 0.91 令吉，公众部分超额认购 0.59 倍。公司于 11 月 6 日召开第 14 届常年股东大会，所有普通决议案均获通过。此外，集团首席执行官 Dato' Lee Yeow Seng 在公开市场增持公司股份，并辞去 IOI Corp 非执行董事职务以专注领导 IOIPG。
notable: IOIPG REIT 的 IPO 发售价定为每单位 0.91 令吉，公众部分超额认购 0.59 倍。
第 14 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 6 日举行，所有普通决议案获股东通过。
集团首席执行官 Dato' Lee Yeow Seng 于 2026 年 11 月 5 日及 6 日在公开市场各增持 300 万股。
risks: Dato' Lee Yeow Seng 辞去 IOI Corp 非执行董事职务。
公司于 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次发布涉及雇员公积金局（EPF）股权变动的公告。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 13.87 亿令吉，环比增长 32.4%，同比增长 55.8%；净利润为 5.23 亿令吉，环比增长 102.7%，但同比下降 36.5%；净利率为 37.7%，高于上一季度的 24.6%。

recent_en: IOIPG is proceeding with the IPO of its REIT, with the institutional and final retail price fixed at RM0.91 per unit and the public tranche oversubscribed 0.59 times. The company held its 14th AGM on 6 November, where all ordinary resolutions were passed. In addition, Group CEO Dato' Lee Yeow Seng acquired shares in the open market and resigned as non-executive director of IOI Corp to focus on leading IOIPG.
notable_en: The IPO price for IOIPG REIT was fixed at RM0.91 per unit, with the public tranche oversubscribed 0.59 times.
The 14th AGM was held on 6 November 2026, and all ordinary resolutions were passed by shareholders.
Group CEO Dato' Lee Yeow Seng acquired 3 million shares each on 5 and 6 November 2026 in the open market.
risks_en: Dato' Lee Yeow Seng resigned as non-executive director of IOI Corp.
The company issued multiple announcements regarding changes in substantial shareholder interest by the Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) between October and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1.387 billion, up 32.4% QoQ and 55.8% YoY; net income was RM523.1 million, up 102.7% QoQ but down 36.5% YoY; net margin was 37.7%, higher than 24.6% in the previous quarter.
